sentence: This project builds virtual reality training modules and compares what people learn from them with what they learn from traditional on-site training.
This project surveys flowering plants to find which ones carry fungi in their seeds and studies how these fungi affect plant diversity.
This project builds an automated system of 1,000 microchemostats that uses machine learning to run experiments on yeast and other microbial cells.
This project tries to build nano-oscillator devices that use antiferromagnets and a special kind of spin current to make high frequency signals.
This project builds models of M dwarf stars, using machine learning, so that the atmospheres of terrestrial exoplanets can be read.
This project builds quantum algorithms that solve statistics and decision-making problems faster than classical methods.
This project builds deep-learning models that follow the laws of physics so scientists can learn how complex physical processes work from data.
This project builds a method to print fine patterns of liquid metal for stretchable electronics using particles that assemble themselves.
This project studies how salt in the water changes plant growth and carbon storage in coastal wetlands.
This project supports a conference that brings together scientists working where computer science and biology meet.
This project studies how the proteins in Antarctic fishes change when the fishes are exposed to heat.
This project tests whether liposomes, tiny lipid-based sacs, can carry drugs to the lymphatic system to kill adult worms that cause lymphatic filariasis.
This project builds a model of the steps in CRISPR gene editing to predict how well the editing works.
This project studies which viruses infect which photosynthetic bacteria in the ocean and how these infections change over time.
This project studies how bacteria switch on a toxin during stress by looking at how proteins remove the antitoxin that holds it in check.
This project uses computer simulations to find out how a small molecule called molecular glue helps two proteins bind together.
